about: The singularity check before a move, on URSim CB3 3.15.8 (UR10), with the owner's TCP set on the controller (0, 0, 157 mm, -90 deg about z): every configuration's verdict, least singular value and condition number through the controller's own getForwardKinematics (12 round trips each), recorded 2026-10-09 by scratchpad judgeio/ursim_singularity.py. 'nominal' is the controller as shipped, 'calibrated' the same with a calibration.conf adding theta, a, d and alpha deltas of up to 3.5 mrad and 1.3 mm. The first 21 are the ends of the lines the cell checked before a moveL on 2026-10-07/08 (robot.log, rebuilt from the routes' logged joint travel), the rest lines toward the wrist, elbow and shoulder singularities sampled around where the verdict flips, down to 1e-7 rad of it.
